thread:
Maria K: Draft attached — product launch post for Redwood Optimize v1. Please quick-pass headline, the benchmark line, and confirm webinar slot + lead routing. Plan: publish Tue AM, webinar Wed 10am PT, benchmark: "30-60% cost reduction vs baseline". Need final numbers and any legal flags. @Liam @Sophia @Elaine @Mark S
Jake R: looking now :eyes:
Liam (Growth): headline feels long. Suggest: "Cut inference costs by 30% with Redwood Optimize" — more direct. Also can we qualify 'inference' with 'token' or 'per-token cost'? quick thought.
Sophia (Comms): prefer not to lead with % if legal needs more nuance. Maybe "significantly lowers per-token cost" and call out the 30% in the subhead/benchmark section. Also webinar CTA should be earlier in post.
Elaine (SEO): current headline ok for CTR but add modifier "for production LLMs" — matches intent. Also need H2 with keywords: "LLM inference cost", "model serving optimization".
Mark S (Sales): Webinar Wed 10am PT is tight for EMEA. Can we record and have an evening slot for APAC? Also confirm lead routing: HubSpot form -> MQL to SDR queue; please add hidden field source=blog_launch_optimize.
Maria K: Good recs. For benchmark numbers — Research/Infra gave internal numbers showing 28-33% mean cost reduction across three workloads when using batching + cache. I'll attach csv. Any objections to calling it "~30%" in subhead?
Jake R: "~30%" reads safe. For primary headline I'd go with Liam's short version, subhead with "~30% avg cost reduction across production workloads".
Sophia (Comms): Can Legal take a quick pass on "~30%" copy? @LegalBot
LegalBot: Quick check queued. Flag: if csv data derived from internal synthetic workloads, need qualifier: "based on internal benchmarks across selected workloads". Also avoid absolute guarantees. Recommend: "up to 30%" or "~30% average" with qualifier.
Elaine (SEO): If we use "up to 30%" that's different for search intent. Prefer "~30% average" and qualifier in the paragraph. Also add open graph title variation shorter.
Mark S (Sales): For lead routing, confirm: form fields: name, company, email, use-case, annual spend bucket. Hidden: source=blog_launch_optimize. Send to HubSpot list: Launch-Optimize-2026.
Maria K: Ok I'll update copy: headline = "Cut inference costs by ~30% with Redwood Optimize" subhead = "Average per-token cost reduction across production workloads; internal benchmarks. Webinar Wed 10am PT (recorded)." I'll swap CTA higher. Who can review final by EOD today?
Liam (Growth): I can review in 2 hours.
Jake R: I can do a quick sweep after Liam.
Sophia (Comms): I'll approve copy tone after Jake.
Mark S (Sales): I'll confirm HubSpot mapping after copy locked.
LegalBot: Returned: accept "~30% average" with qualifier line exactly: "Based on internal benchmarks across selected production workloads; results may vary." Provide link to bench note.
Maria K: Thanks — I'll add qualifier verbatim and attach bench note + webinar registration form config. Will schedule webinar and set record option.
Jake R: small nit — change CTA text to "Register for the webinar" instead of "Join" for better conversion in past tests.
Elaine (SEO): Also ensure meta description < 160 chars. I'll draft one after final headline.
Maria K: Great. Plan: I'll push updated draft to doc, update HubSpot form, and ping here when live. Target publish Tue 09:00 PT. Thanks all :pray:
Sophia (Comms): :thumbsup:
Liam (Growth): :rocket:
Mark S (Sales): :thumbsup:
